content.text:
Skipped typecheck (command needs approval; also `node_modules` may be absent in this worktree).

Added Promotions panel to admin dashboard.

- `app/admin/promotions/page.tsx`: new route, renders the view.
- `components/admin/AdminPromotionsView.tsx`: new view. It fetches `GET /api/admin/promotions` and shows a table with code and title, discount, min order, usage (used / limit), validity dates, and a status badge (Active, Inactive, Scheduled or Expired). It has loading, error with retry, and empty states plus a refresh button. Delete opens a confirm modal, then calls `DELETE /api/admin/promotions?id=`. It toasts the result and refreshes the list.
- `components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx`: added a "Promotions" link under Commerce.

The delete route returns `success: true` even when nothing was deleted (`deleted: false`), so the UI checks `deleted` and shows an error in that case.

I did not run a typecheck or open it in a browser, so nothing is verified yet. Fixed-amount discounts show with a ₱ sign, an assumption based on the PHP retail pricing in your recent commits.
